heading: Getting to Big Sky
intro: Plan to arrive Thursday, February 18, and depart Monday, February 22. Please try to coordinate arrival and departure times with the group so we can share the drive between Bozeman and the house.

items.title: Fly into Bozeman
items.description: Bozeman Yellowstone International Airport is the arrival airport for the weekend. Check directly with your airline for flight schedules.

items.title: Carter's flights
items.description: American Airlines. All times are local to each airport. Similar arrival and departure times will help us coordinate shared rides.

items.title: Coordinate your travel
items.description: The drive from Bozeman to the house takes approximately 1.5 hours. Text Carter your flight plans and try to coordinate arrival and departure times with others so we can share rides. Allow additional time for winter conditions, rental returns, and airport check-in.

items.title: Rental cars
items.description: Rental cars and shared rides will be coordinated once flight plans come together. Driver, vehicle, and passenger arrangements will follow.

items.title: Stay at the house
items.description: We will be staying together at a house at Yellowstone Club. Lodging is provided at no cost to guests. The address and private arrival instructions will be shared in Partiful.

items.title: Arriving Wednesday?
items.description: Some guests are arriving Wednesday, February 17, and spending the night in Bozeman. You are welcome to do the same! Please arrange your own lodging for Wednesday night; our stay at the house begins Thursday.
